nodes.label: Capa de Fuentes de datos (Room, DAOs, Entities, contenido semilla)
nodes.norm_label: capa de fuentes de datos (room, daos, entities, contenido semilla)

nodes.label: Capa de Negocio
nodes.rationale: Game rules independent of Room and Android; works with domain models and repository interfaces.

nodes.label: Capa de Presentacion (Jetpack Compose)
nodes.rationale: Screens, state and navigation only; no business rules.

nodes.label: Diseno de la base de datos (25 tablas)
nodes.norm_label: diseno de la base de datos (25 tablas)
nodes.rationale: Local SQLite via Room because the project has no own servers; logical relations only (no foreign keys); lists stored as text via Converters.

nodes.label: MOD-01 Sistema de Hidromiel
nodes.rationale: Single point for level state/cost, entry and help charges, rewards and daily reward; delegates to ControlAcceso, PoliticaCosto (C=20), CalculadoraRecompensa and ReservaHidromiel (balance never negative, RN-01).

nodes.label: ValidarRespuestaUseCase compartido
nodes.rationale: Shared multiple-choice validator (correcta/incompleta/incorrecta) reused by leccion, pregunta flash, diagnostico, Ragnarok and contrarreloj.

nodes.label: Base de datos v9 (fallbackToDestructiveMigration)
nodes.rationale: Destructive migration wipes progress and reseeds data when installing over an older version.

nodes.label: Hidromiel (contador y avisos)
nodes.rationale: Counter looks identical on all game screens; popups only for daily and level rewards because charges are already visible in the counter.

nodes.label: Pozo de Mimir (CU-10) y repaso
nodes.rationale: Review fountain sleeps until the world Ragnarok is beaten (or admin mode); 10 questions spread across the world lessons, no hidromiel cost or reward.

nodes.label: Tipografias opcionales Cinzel y Alegreya
nodes.rationale: Optional OFL fonts; falls back to the system serif with simulated small caps when the ttf files are missing.

nodes.label: Software Components Specification Sprint 2 - secciones actualizadas
nodes.norm_label: software components specification sprint 2 - secciones actualizadas

nodes.label: Convenciones de diagramas de secuencia
nodes.rationale: One lifeline per layer, MOD-01 entry charge as a ref fragment, repeated actions in a loop, only main alternate flows - so each sequence diagram fits on one page.

nodes.label: Excepcion controlada HidromielFlashRepositoryImpl
nodes.rationale: The only allowed upward dependency: persistence impl delegates to ModuloHidromiel so every hidromiel movement passes through MOD-01.

nodes.label: Inversion de dependencias
nodes.rationale: Use cases depend only on repository interfaces, never implementations; dependencies always flow Presentacion -> Negocio -> Persistencia -> Fuentes de datos.

nodes.label: Modo admin oculto
nodes.rationale: Secret tap combination 1-2-4-3 twice on Mundos unlocks all worlds/levels, free entries and crossword helps, wakes Mimir well, all runes in contrarreloj; persisted in SharedPreferences odin/modo_admin so it survives restarts (testing aid).

nodes.label: Tercer anillo y retos de arrastrar y soltar (CU-09)
nodes.norm_label: tercer anillo y retos de arrastrar y soltar (cu-09)
nodes.rationale: Third ring of hexagon challenges (8 per world), each linked to the two nearest ring-2 minigames; only positions 1 (ORDENAR_PROCESO) and 5 (COMPLETAR_DIAGRAMA) playable, the rest "Por definir". Score 100 minus 20 per wrong confirmation, ends at the 3rd failure. DB v7 reseeds on upgrade.
